Fils de forgeron, apprenti relieur, il a: A blacksmith's son, apprenticed to a bookbinder, he learned science by reading the books he bound. He discovered electromagnetic induction in 1831. To a minister who asked what electricity was good for: “One day, sir, you may tax it.” The retort is probably made up.
Fille de Byron, elle écrit en 1843 le pr: Byron's daughter, she wrote the first published program in 1843, for Babbage's Analytical Engine, and foresaw that a machine might compose music. Her mother had raised her on mathematics to protect her from the “madness” she attributed to her father.
Haut fonctionnaire de la dynastie Song,: A high official of the Song dynasty, he noted in 1088 that a magnetized needle does not point exactly north: the first known description of magnetic declination. He also described Bi Sheng's movable-type printing and the formation of fossils.
En 1921, sur le bateau du retour, il se: In 1921, on the ship home, he wonders why the sea is blue. In Calcutta, he discovers that a small part of the light scattered by molecules changes color: the Raman effect. Nobel Prize 1930; he had booked his trip to Stockholm months before the announcement.
Professeur de lycée à Cologne, il publie: A secondary-school teacher in Cologne, he published his law in 1827 after months of measurements. In Germany, the reception was cold; he left his post. It took the Royal Society of London awarding him the Copley Medal in 1841 for his country to take him seriously.
Coinventeur du transistor en 1947, il es: Co-inventor of the transistor in 1947, he is the only person to have received the Nobel Prize in physics twice. In 1956, he brought only one of his three children to Stockholm. The King of Sweden chided him; he promised to come back with all of them. In 1972, he did, with all three.
Son moteur à courant alternatif l'emport: His alternating-current motor beat Edison's direct current in the “war of the currents”: our grids come from it. He also promised wireless power and a death ray, never built. He died alone and in debt in a New York hotel room, where he looked after pigeons.
